context: Dame Guisarme is a veteran patron at the Elfsong Tavern speaking from the perspective of a seasoned combatant about a recent string of serial killings that have left the district nervous. She openly criticizes the Flaming Fist for failing to catch the murderer and expects others — including the player, who has likely been investigating or warning people about the killer — to share her frustration. Tavern gossip and off‑screen reactions vary (some townsfolk like Nesha are flippant, others are grieving or suspicious), and nearby developments—such as Yannis taking on duties after Father Lorgan’s death—add to the unease. Scattered lines in other scenes reinforce a visible Flaming Fist presence (patrolling guards, gate sentries) and a common view here that the Fist are better at crowd control than subtle investigations.
